visual_summary: In a metallic interior, a crowd of squat, armed-looking robots argues while facing one another across a lit corridor. The scene then shifts to a large screen or projection showing the stern face of the Metabaron. Small figures and machinery cluster around the display as they zoom in on his right eyebrow. The final panels isolate the eyebrow scar and a blue spherical device or image element while a robot gives an exact timestamp for when the scar tissue formed.
